description: CONCORD — U.S. Sen. Maggie Hassan offered her heartfelt congratulations last weekend in announcing first-term state Rep. David Paige (D-Conway) is the recipient of the 2023 Spirit of Opportunity Award during the 2023 Midterm Convention of the New Hampshire Democratic Party. One of three awards announced at the N.H. Democratic Convention, the honor recognized Paige […]

title: Rep. Paige Receives Spirit of Opportunity Award - David For NH
